messages.subject: Live music — Jake Essex
messages.body:
Hi,

I'm Natalie, I look after bookings for Jake Essex.

Jake is a professional solo vocalist from Essex. High-energy 50s and 60s rock and roll. He is the act. No impersonations, no jumpsuit, no corny gimmicks. The night has a shape: raw 50s through to 70s Vegas, plus Darin, Dion, Holly, Orbison, Sinatra. Real voice. Own PA, fully self-contained, no deposit.

This is for the club at Radburn Pavilion on Latton Common. He'd be the act for a members' night there.

Have a look: http://jakeessex.co.uk

Friday nights, Saturdays, Sundays and functions this year and into 2027. 2 × 45 or 3 × 45. If a date works, reply here and I'll lock it.

Best,
Natalie
Jake Essex Music
